answer: On the wind-cut tundra, an identity is a single frost locker no twin can rent. An applicant bonds 8.40 POA and draws one of 22 vaults lined with copper for 17 minutes. They cut a 24.7 cm permafrost core, stamp a 16-bit lens hash of ice-layer count, pubkey, and epoch seed onto the copper lid, and seat it in that vault in seconds 18-44. 96 aliases would freeze 806.40 POA and need 96 exclusive vaults. Auditors replay the vault draw from the seed, regenerate the hash, and measure the core to 0.08 cm. A reused vault, thawed core, or hash clash burns 51% and seals that locker for 8 epochs.
